title: Bee Removal in Midwood, Brooklyn
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Midwood, Brooklyn. Nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Midwood residents know that our tree-lined streets and classic brick homes create ideal nesting spots for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees, especially during spring and summer months. The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional nest treatment and removal throughout Midwood, from Avenue M to Kings Highway. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat it directly, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Midwood's diverse community for years, understanding the unique challenges of both single-family homes and multi-unit buildings common in this neighborhood.
localContext: Midwood's abundance of gardens around Brooklyn College and well-maintained yards near the historic Vitagraph Studios area often attract wasps, hornets, and carpenter bees seeking shelter in eaves, chimneys, and wall voids. The neighborhood's mix of pre-war apartment buildings and detached homes means paper wasp nests, bald-faced hornet nests, and carpenter bee galleries can go unnoticed until populations grow large. Yellow jackets frequently nest in ground burrows in yards and along building foundations. Each species requires targeted treatment—locating the nest entrance, treating the colony directly, removing accessible nest material, and sealing openings to stop recolonization.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Midwood?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Midwood?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in Midwood?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day service throughout Midwood. Most calls are answered within hours, and our technicians can typically arrive the same day to address urgent situations — especially when a nest is near entrances, play areas, or poses a risk to children, pets, or individuals with allergies.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: After the nest is treated and removed, we seal every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
